To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the chemical and biological diversity of natural products from plants in China is very rich and that the structural diversity and bioactivities of the compounds are closely related.

(1) the chemical constituents and biological activities of the TCMs are highly diverse; (2) the chemical constituents of the TCM are highly variable, even within the same species; (3) the chemical constituents are highly dependent on the extraction conditions, such as extraction solvents, extraction temperatures and times, and extraction procedures; and (4) the chemical constituents can be modified to improve biological activity.
we have identified a large number of novel and biologically significant compounds and derivatives from plant resources in the past decade.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the chemical and biological investigations of the plant resources, which are mainly focused on the chemical and biological studies on the plant resources in China.
the chemical and pharmacological investigation of plant resources, especially the TCM, and the development of new drug candidates from the TCM.
the isolation, identification, structural modification, and biological evaluation of bioactive compounds from natural resources, and the development of new drugs from these compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have made a series of significant achievements in the discovery of structurally diverse natural compounds and/or their derivatives from plant resources in the past decade.

the structural diversity of the compounds from plant resources is enormous and that the structural modification of the biologically important compounds from plants is an effective way to obtain more active and/or structurally novel compounds.
the structural diversity and biological significance of plant-derived natural products are not limited to a few classes of compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the structural diversity and the biological significance of the compounds from plant resources are closely correlated with each other, and the structural modification of the bioactive compounds from plants can lead to a series of derivatives with improved bioactivity and/or novel structures.

the structural diversity, the structural modification, and the biological evaluation of compounds from plants (or TCMs) in China are very important for the discovery of novel and biologically significant compounds.

the chemical diversity of plant resources is much greater than we thought, and the chemical diversity and biological activities of plant resources in China are much more abundant than that in other countries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
plant resources are an important source of novel and structurally diverse natural products with significant biological activities.
the plant resources are a rich source for drug discovery and development.
the plant resources of China are a treasure house for the discovery of novel bioactive natural products, which will be a rich source for drug discovery in the coming decades.
